purpose: Define and execute Book-owned semantic backup-set, restore-acceptance, offline-continuity and crash-recovery semantics while delegating generic physical persistence, backup and restore mechanics to CORE.

book_owns: semantic backup-set membership and exact identities
Book-side durability request construction and provider receipt admission
restore semantic acceptance and stale/current classification
forbidden: BOOK implementing a second physical backup/store/restore platform
BOOK directly reading or writing CORE-private storage/database state
restored historical bytes silently replacing a newer canonical Book subject
active PROSE provider, consumer, dependency or execution lane

semantic_backup_set.dependency_identity_rule: Every dependency has one stable dependency_id, exact ref, SHA-256 digest, owner_path and currentness classification. Duplicate ids or refs fail closed.
semantic_backup_set.rebuild_rule: Rebuild recipes and index-version identities are semantic recovery metadata. Each category must be PRESENT with exact version/digest entries or explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE; silent omission is forbidden.
semantic_backup_set.physical_payload_rule: The Book semantic manifest contains references/digests only and never stores physical payload bytes.

core_p03_dependency.dispatch_rule: A runtime registration supplied by CORE must be REGISTERED_ACTIVE, owned by SYSTEM_MASTER/CORE, use an operation_id shaped CORE.P03.COMMAND.<OPERATION_NAME>, deny Book canonical-write authority, and match the requested semantic role. Absent registration fails CORE_DURABILITY_INTERFACE_UNAVAILABLE.

restore_acceptance_invariants: The restored semantic-manifest digest must equal the requested exact manifest digest.
The restored canonical and manuscript digests must equal the preserved subject digests.
Every preserved dependency digest must be reproduced exactly.
The physical manifest digest must bind to the admitted CORE durability receipt.
The restore must be evidenced as destructive/test-environment restore execution rather than an untested copy claim.
The reproduced final-expression digest must equal the preserved manuscript digest.
If current canonical Book state advanced after preservation, restore may be accepted as a verified historical snapshot but may not satisfy the current PRESERVATION gate or overwrite current state.
Only exact-current restore proof may satisfy G19/PRESERVATION_COMPLETE.

offline_continuity.rule: Offline peer-required operations block rather than fabricate a provider result. Local semantic verification may continue only from already-present exact evidence.

crash_recovery.rule: If an exact matching CORE receipt already exists, reconcile it instead of issuing a duplicate provider command. If canonical state advanced, stop retry and re-plan preservation for the new subject.

non_claims: This profile does not claim CORE currently exposes a registered durability or restore operation.
This profile does not implement physical storage, backup, checksum, archive or restore mechanics inside BOOK.
This profile does not grant canonical mutation authority outside BOOK-COMP-02.
This profile does not make Book complete, whole-app qualified, publication-authorized or production-certified.
